scope: Targeted GEO search for future age-appropriate independent whole-testis models, not exhaustive systematic review or automatic inclusion.
queries: gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND ("meiotic arrest" OR "spermatogenic arrest")
gse[ETYP] AND "Mus musculus"[Organism] AND (testis OR testes) AND (Meioc OR Ythdc2 OR Taf7l OR Tex11 OR Dmrt7 OR Setx)
server_filters: Series and Mus musculus; text terms only, not reliable tissue/age/assay/phenotype validation.
local_review_criteria: Whole testis bulk RNA sequencing rather than only purified cells, single-cell, ChIP, or another organ.
Prefer sampling at P10-P30 with source-confirmed age; keep other ages explicit, never guess adult.
At least three biological control and perturbation samples in a compatible age/target contrast; source repeat labels alone do not establish animal independence.
Explicit genotype/control/Cre and count-file units; no normalized noninteger matrix admitted as raw counts by rounding.
Require primary paper or histology evidence before calling an age-specific contrast an established spermatogenic-arrest model.
Prioritize new genetic models; same model ages are not extra independent votes. Do not select by correlation with primary results.
output: Exact query responses, complete UID count reconciliation within each bounded query, accession/title/summary inventory, then explicit targeted metadata review. No automatic changes to primary analysis.
identifier_resolution: Resolve numerical Entrez UIDs through ESummary accession fields; no UID arithmetic.
metadata_selection: Twelve RNA-expression-labelled candidate series in the returned inventory, spanning proposed Setx, Ythdc2, Eef1g, Ash2l, TDP-43 and CFP1 contexts. These names are search leads, not verified eligibility. Selected before inspecting sample-level expression or candidate concordance.
access: Public unauthenticated API, serialized <=2 requests/sec; downloads must use configured HTTP(S) proxy from first attempt, no direct fallback.
